title: No Early Visit to the Second Exit State
statement: Let $M_1$ and $M_2$ be machines with $k$ work tapes over a common alphabet, with state sets $S_1,S_2$. Choose $exit\in S_1$ and $entry,q_2\in S_2$. Suppose the run of $M_1$ from configuration $c_0$ reaches configuration $c_1$ at time $T_1$, with state $exit$, and avoids $exit$ at every time $t<T_1$. Suppose also that the run of $M_2$ from $c_1$ with its state replaced by $entry$ avoids $q_2$ at every time $t<T_2$. Then the seam-composed run from $c_0$ with state embedded in the left component does not have state $q_2$ embedded in the right component at any time $t<T_1+1+T_2$.
